review_candidates.description: Background JOB DESCRIPTION UN Women, grounded in the vision of equality enshrined in the Charter of the United Nations, works for the elimination of discrimination against women and girls; the empowerment of women; and the achievement of equality between women and men as partners and beneficiaries of development, human rights, humanitarian action and peace and security. The Division of Communications and Advocacy (DCA) leads UN Women’s global communications and advocacy efforts to advance gender equality and women’s empowerment, strengthen the organization’s visibility and positioning, and engage audiences across digital, media and public-facing platforms. Within DCA, the social media team develops and implements content and campaigns for UN Women’s global social media channels and provides guidance to colleagues across the organization on social media account management and engagement. Reporting to the Social Media Specialist, the Communications Associate manages an assigned portfolio of social media content, campaigns and account-related activities, taking responsibility for delivery from planning and production through publication, engagement and evaluation. The Associate exercises editorial, analytical and operational judgment within agreed strategies and clearance protocols, coordinates with headquarters, regional and country office colleagues, and provides technical guidance to support consistent messaging and operational continuity. Scope of Work Coordinate social media content and campaign delivery Manage the planning and delivery of the assigned social media portfolio, translating agreed strategies into content plans and publishing schedules, and coordinating scheduling adjustments with the Social Media Specialist. Develop concepts and guide production of content packages across languages, formats and platforms, including event coverage, video and graphics; create and edit Canva assets as needed. Draft, edit, adapt and quality-assure content for global channels, exercising editorial judgment, identifying sensitive content and ensuring the appropriate editorial review and clearance. Coordinate inputs, multilingual adaptations, production and clearances with colleagues across headquarters, regional and country offices, resolving delivery issues and ensuring timely publication. Manage audience engagement and account operations Manage day-to-day publishing and audience engagement within the assigned portfolio across global accounts serving large and diverse audiences, ensuring consistency and continuity of delivery. Assess and respond to comments, queries and sensitive or critical engagement within the assigned portfolio, in line with the agreed escalation protocol; resolve engagement issues within delegated authority and escalate high-risk or reputational matters to the Social Media Specialist. Maintain publishing workflows and coordinate technical follow-up on platform changes, maintaining account records and practical guidance to support operational continuity. Coordinate performance analysis, reporting and knowledge sharing Analyze quantitative and qualitative social media results using publishing, monitoring and analytics tools, including social listening and sentiment analysis as relevant to the assigned portfolio. Evaluate content and campaign performance, prepare analytical reports and use findings to improve content, formats and publishing schedules within the assigned portfolio and agreed social media strategy. Assess platform developments and audience trends and advise the Social Media Specialist on adaptations to strengthen audience growth, engagement and effective platform use. Share findings, technical guidance and good practices across teams and offices to improve content quality, coordination and social media delivery. The incumbent performs other duties within their functional profile as deemed necessary for the efficient functioning of the Office and the Organization. Competencies Core Values: Integrity; Professionalism; Respect for Diversity. Core Competencies Awareness and Sensitivity Regarding Gender Issues; Accountability; Creative Problem Solving; Effective Communication; Inclusive Collaboration; Stakeholder Engagement; Leading by Example. Please visit this link for more information on UN Women’s Values and Competencies Framework: Functional Competencies Strong understanding of major digital platforms and strategic social media outreach for international audiences. Ability to manage and deliver an assigned portfolio of social media content and campaigns, coordinating inputs, timelines and publication across multiple platforms. Excellent writing and editing skills, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences, formats and platforms. Strong editorial judgment, including political and ethical awareness and the ability to assess sensitive content and audience engagement issues. Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative performance data and translate findings into improvements in content and engagement. Strong technical knowledge of social media publishing and account management tools, including the ability to provide guidance and resolve operational queries. Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to exercise initiative, balance competing priorities and deliver under tight deadlines. Ability to coordinate effectively with colleagues across teams and regions. Knowledge of gender equality and women’s empowerment issues. Education And Credentials Completion of secondary education is required. A bachelor’s degree in communications, public relations, journalism or a related field is desirable. Experience At least seven years of progressively responsible experience in communications, including writing, editing and creating social media content, is required. Four years with a bachelor’s degree may be considered instead. Experience coordinating, implementing and evaluating social media campaigns is required. Demonstrated experience managing the planning and delivery of social media content across multiple platforms is required. Experience using online publishing and social media management tools, such as Hootsuite or equivalent platforms, is required. Experience measuring and analyzing social media reach and engagement, including reporting on quantitative and qualitative results, is required. Experience coordinating content production with colleagues across teams or offices is required. Experience creating and editing graphic assets using Canva is desirable. Experience working on women’s rights and gender equality issues is desirable. Familiarity with the United Nations system is desirable. Language Fluency in English is required. Knowledge of another official UN language is desirable (French, Arabic, Chinese, Russian or Spanish). Statements In July 2010, the United Nations General Assembly created UN Women, the United Nations Entity for Gender Equality and the Empowerment of Women. The creation of UN Women came about as part of the UN reform agenda, bringing together resources and mandates for greater impact. It merges and builds on the important work of four previously distinct parts of the UN system (DAW, OSAGI, INSTRAW and UNIFEM), which focused exclusively on gender equality and women's empowerment. Diversity And Inclusion At UN Women, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment of mutual respect. UN Women recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, national origin, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, competence, integrity and organizational need. If you need any reasonable accommodation to support your participation in the recruitment and selection process, please include this information in your application. UN Women has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UN Women, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination. All selected candidates will be expected to adhere to UN Women’s policies and procedures and the standards of conduct expected of UN Women personnel and will therefore undergo rigorous reference and background checks. (Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check.) Note: Applicants must ensure that all sections of the application form, including the sections on education and employment history, are completed. If all sections are not completed the application may be disqualified from the recruitment and selection process .

review_candidates.description: Description Do you want to work to make Power for Good? RES is the world’s largest independent renewable energy company.We're guided by a simple yet powerful vision: to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy. We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we're tackling some of the world's toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They're our most important asset so that's why we continually invest in them. The RES group is a family with a diverse workforce, and we are dedicated tothe personal professional growth of our people, no matter what stage of their career they're at. We can promise you rewarding work which makes a real impact, the chance to learn from inspiring colleagues from across a growing, global network and opportunities to grow personally and professionally. Job Purpose The Technician(Solar) is a field-based role performing operations and maintenance duties on utility-scale ground mounted solar PV plants & BESS. The overall purpose of the role is to ensure the plants achieve outstanding levels of safety, quality and performance at a cost that meets operational budget, as part of an industry leading team of renewable energy specialists. The ideal candidate will be a fully qualified electrician with experience operating and maintaining MW-scale power plants, with DC and HV electrical competencies. This is a permanent role and will require availability for weekend on-call duties as part of a rota. An overtime system is in place. A company vehicle, smart phone and laptop/tablet will be provided. RES provides a comprehensive package of benefits including contributory pension, private health insurance and investment in role specific training. Strong candidates will have the opportunity to work towards Authorised Person (AP) or Senior Authorised Person (SAP) status. RES pride ourselves on our in-house training programme and as such a full training programme is provided. Technicians who demonstrate an attitude and aptitude for career progression will be encouraged to broaden their experience to advanced levels such as an industry recognised HV Authorised Person (AP) or Senior Authorised Person (SAP). For team members who embody our values of Passion, Accountability, Collaboration and Excellence, the opportunities for growth are huge. KeyAccountabilities Adherence to and management of health and safety requirements at all times and helping to maintain and improve safety standards across the plants. Achieve and maintain Authorised Person status commensurate with training received, experience gained and in-line with individual job role requirements. Undertaking planned inspection and maintenance according to legal, technical, manufacturer and contractual requirements. Inspection, testing and maintenance of plant and equipment. Undertaking AC and DC system testing, troubleshooting and fault-finding. Carry out reactive maintenance, fault diagnosis and resolution in a timely manner. Troubleshooting and repairs on sensors and communication equipment including RS485, Ethernet and fibre optic networks. Configuration of computer-based devices and components, including firmware updates. Occasionally assisting with ground maintenance, cleaning or mechanical work. Induct and manage sub-contractors, ensure their safe working and undertake quality checks on their work. Keeping accurate maintenance records and compiling reports. Keeping in close communication with the O&M office and team functions. Travelling between the sites and offices. Occasionally working away from home for training courses or to cover other sites for up to 1 week at a time. Other duties commensurate with the role. Monitor equipment utilization, condition, downtime, maintenance compliance, and repair status across assigned projects. Review recurring failures and equipment performance trends and develop corrective action plans. Support troubleshooting and escalation of complex hydraulic, mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, diesel, and automated control system issues. Coordinate with Engineering, vendors, Fleet Maintenance Center personnel, and operational stakeholders to resolve technical issues. Verify maintenance standards, repair quality, and operational readiness of fleet assets. Remove unsafe or unserviceable equipment from operation when required and facilitate corrective actions. Maintenance Planning & Documentation Ensure all maintenance activities are properly documented within MaintainX or approved CMMS platforms. Review work orders, inspections, labor entries, parts usage, and repair records for accuracy and completeness. Monitor preventive maintenance compliance and overdue service requirements. Maintain accurate records supporting regulatory compliance, fleet analytics, equipment history, and performance reporting. Develop and communicate maintenance schedules and fleet readiness reports to leadership. Conduct routine safety observations, audits, inspections, and follow-up corrective actions. Ensure Field Mechanic I, Field Mechanic II, and Field Mechanic III personnel follow approved maintenance procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, and safe work practices. Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and implementation of corrective actions. Maintain compliance with project-specific and regulatory maintenance requirements. Inventory, Parts & Vendor Coordination Coordinate with Inventory Specialists to ensure adequate stock of critical spare parts, tools, consumables, and maintenance materials. Monitor inventory levels and communicate shortages through established escalation channels. Support management of vendor relationships, equipment manufacturers, service providers, and labor partners. Assist in procurement planning, equipment mobilization, and asset deployment activities. Team Development Mentor and develop Field Mechanic I, Field Mechanic II, and Field Mechanic III personnel through training, coaching, performance feedback, field evaluations, and career development planning. Support technical development programs focused on diagnostic skills, preventive maintenance, safety, and equipment operation. Identify future leaders and assist with succession planning efforts. Promote standardization of maintenance practices throughout the organization. Required Experience & Qualifications Minimum 10 years of experience maintaining and repairing heavy equipment, drilling equipment, construction machinery, or similar industrial equipment. Minimum 5 years of leadership experience supervising maintenance personnel, field service teams, or fleet operations. Demonstrated experience managing maintenance activities across multiple construction projects or geographic regions. Advanced knowledge of: Diesel engines Hydraulic systems Electrical systems Pneumatic systems Mechanical drive systems Electronic controls and machine automation systems Experience utilizing CMMS platforms, maintenance tracking software, and equipment diagnostics systems. Strong understanding of equipment reliability programs, preventive maintenance, and root cause failure analysis. Valid driver's license and ability to travel extensively. Preferred Experience supporting deep foundation, solar, renewable energy, heavy civil, utility, or infrastructure construction operations. Technical certification, trade school training, military technical training, or apprenticeship completion. ASE, OEM, or related technical certifications. OSHA 30 certification. Experience with telematics systems, fleet analytics, and maintenance reporting platforms. Familiarity with Caterpillar, Bauer, Liebherr, Soilmec, Manitowoc, and similar foundation construction equipment. Key Competencies Safety Leadership Fleet Reliability Management Team Leadership & Development Operational Excellence Maintenance Planning Equipment Diagnostics & Troubleshooting Root Cause Analysis Change Management Communication & Stakeholder Management Customer Focus Problem Solving & Decision Making Budget & Resource Management Continuous Improvement Reporting Structure Reports To Senior Manager, Foundation Field Operations Direct Reports May Include Field Mechanic III (Lead Field Mechanics) Field Mechanic II Field Mechanic I Inventory Specialists Contract Maintenance Personnel Field Mechanic III personnel function as senior technical resources and field leads, reporting directly to the Superintendent while providing day-to-day technical guidance and mentoring to Field Mechanic II and Field Mechanic I personnel. Physical Requirements Ability to work at active construction and industrial project sites. Ability to walk on uneven terrain and perform site inspections. Ability to lift, climb, bend, and work around heavy equipment. Ability to work outdoors in varied weather conditions. Frequent travel throughout North America and other project locations as required. Our comprehensive portfolio enables faster project delivery, higher performance, and greater reliability, helping our customers capture the full value of solar power. Our talented worldwide teams are redefining how solar power plants are designed, built, and operated every day with smart technology, data-driven insights, and advanced automation. Together, we’re building the foundation for the world’s next generation of clean energy infrastructure. Nextpower is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We are Nextpower

Promote application of lessons learned across the technical assistance portfolio.
